title: Hot Mustardy Thai Duck Yum Salad
description: A spicy and savory Thai-inspired salad featuring duck, mustard, and a variety of fresh herbs, all mixed together in a zesty dressing. This dish is low in calories and rich in flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the duck breast with salt and black pepper.
Heat the duck fat in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the duck breast until browned on both sides.
Transfer the duck breast to the oven and roast for 15 minutes, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the duck breast rest for 5 minutes before slicing it into thin strips.
In a large bowl, whisk together the mustard, fish sauce, and lime juice.
Add the sliced chili peppers, mint leaves, cilantro leaves, and scallions to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the sliced duck breast to the bowl and toss to coat with the dressing.
Serve the salad immediately, garnished with additional herbs if desired.
